title: Multi-Object Tracker
text: Create and manage tracks of multiple objects, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Track state parameters} sets Parameters of track state reference frame structure; {Tracker identifier} sets the unique tracker identifier, {Filter initialization function name} sets the kalman filter initialization function, {Threshold for assigning detections to tracks} sets the detection assignment threshold, {M and N for the M-out-of-N confirmation} sets the confirmation parameters for track creation, {P and R for the P-out-of-R deletion} sets the track deletion threshold, {Maximum number of tracks}, {Maximum number of sensors}, {Out-of-sequence measurements handling}, {Update track state parameters with time}, {Prediction time source} sets the source for prediction time, {Enable cost matrix input} enables input port for cost matrix, {Enable detectable track IDs input}, {Source of output bus name}, {Specify an output bus name} sets the name of output bus, {Enable tentative tracks output} enables output port for tentative tracks, {Enable all tracks output} enables output port for all tracks and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
